nodes.label: Board, Directors & Corporate Governance
nodes.summary: Corporate governance requirements for listed companies including board composition, directors' duties, INED requirements, board committees, CG Code compliance, company secretary, and internal controls.

nodes.label: Directors' Duties and Responsibilities
nodes.summary: Directors owe fiduciary duties to the company including duty of care, skill, and diligence; duty to act in good faith; duty to avoid conflicts of interest; and duty to act within powers.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.465 — Directors' Duties
nodes.summary: Directors must act honestly and in good faith in the interests of the company as a whole, and exercise the care, skill, and diligence that a reasonably prudent person would exercise.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.468 — Duty to Avoid Conflicts
nodes.summary: Directors must avoid situations where they have a direct or indirect interest that conflicts with the company's interests.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.08 — Directors' Responsibilities
nodes.summary: Directors are responsible for the overall management of the listed company and must ensure compliance with the Listing Rules.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.09 — Directors' Securities Transactions
nodes.summary: Directors must comply with Model Code for Securities Transactions by Directors.

nodes.label: Independent Non-Executive Director (INED) Requirements
nodes.summary: Listed companies must have at least 3 INEDs, comprising at least one-third of the board. INEDs must meet independence criteria under CG Code and Listing Rules.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.10 — INED Requirements
nodes.summary: At least 3 INEDs must be appointed, comprising at least one-third of the board.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.11 — INED Independence Criteria
nodes.summary: INEDs must meet independence criteria including no material business relationship, no family relationship with executives, and not being a former executive within 3 years.

nodes.label: Board Committees
nodes.summary: Listed companies must establish audit committee, remuneration committee, and nomination committee. Each committee must have written terms of reference.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.23 — Audit Committee
nodes.summary: Audit committee must have at least 3 members, all INEDs, with at least one having financial expertise.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.25 — Remuneration Committee
nodes.summary: Remuneration committee must have at least 3 members, majority INEDs.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.27 — Nomination Committee
nodes.summary: Nomination committee must have at least 3 members, majority INEDs.

nodes.label: Corporate Governance Code
nodes.summary: Appendix C2 to the Listing Rules sets out the Corporate Governance Code with 4 principles, code provisions, and disclosure requirements. Listed companies must report on CG compliance.

nodes.label: MBL Appendix C2 — Corporate Governance Code
nodes.summary: Sets out 4 CG principles: (1) leadership and structure, (2) strategy and performance, (3) responsibilities and accountability, (4) disclosure and transparency.

nodes.label: Company Secretary
nodes.summary: Listed companies must appoint a company secretary who is a qualified solicitor or accountant with sufficient experience. The secretary is responsible for regulatory compliance.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.29 — Company Secretary Qualifications
nodes.summary: Company secretary must be a qualified solicitor or accountant with at least 3 years' relevant experience.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.470 — Company Secretary Duties
nodes.summary: Company secretary must ensure the company complies with the Companies Ordinance and maintains proper registers.

nodes.label: Internal Controls and Risk Management
nodes.summary: The board must maintain adequate internal controls and risk management systems. The audit committee must review internal controls at least annually.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.24 — Internal Controls Review
nodes.summary: Audit committee must review internal controls at least annually and report to the board.

nodes.label: Corporate Governance Report
nodes.summary: Listed companies must include a Corporate Governance Report in their annual report, detailing CG practices, board committee activities, and compliance with CG Code provisions.
